CFG.PROJECT_HELP: The key from /vteam/<projectKey>/, not the numeric DevOps project ID. Configure one provider per CTeam source project; use its default project to choose the destination. The primary type is required, and additional types can be listed below.
CFG.ADDITIONAL_TYPES_HELP: Add one CLASSIFY:MODEL_TYPE_ID pair per line, such as BUG:688 or DEMAND:693. The primary classification and model type above stay included. Additional classifications discover their own dynamic 经办人 field. Keep each pair unique.
CFG.ASSIGNEE: Primary type's dynamic 经办人 search field
CFG.EXCLUDED_HELP: Choose states to exclude for the matching work-item type. No names are hardcoded; an empty selection excludes nothing. Save local credentials in the CTeam plugin settings before loading options.

AUTH.TITLE: CTeam local credentials
AUTH.HELP: These credentials stay on this device and are excluded from app sync and backups. Local secret storage is not encrypted at rest. They are separate from CWLink's own credentials. After saving, configure the CTeam issue provider in Integrations.
AUTH.CONFIGURED: Local credentials are configured. The token is not displayed.
AUTH.ERROR: Could not read or save local credentials.
